print\(''=''*60\)
print\(''SMART GLASSES NAVIGATION - VOICE-GUIDED TEST RUN''\)
print\(''=''*60\)

from tools.navigation.nav_runner import start_navigation, next_navigation_step, get_navigation_status

# Simulate user starting navigation
print\(\)
print\(''USER: ""Navigate to Dean Office from Entrance""''\)
print\(\)
result = start_navigation\(''Entrance'', ''Dean Office''\)
print\(''SYSTEM:''\)
print\(f''  Started session: {result[""session_id""]}''\)
print\(f''  Route: {result[""start""]} -> {result[""destination""]}''\)
print\(f''  Total steps: {result[""total_steps""]}''\)
print\(f''  Message: ""{result[""message""]}""''\)

# Simulate voice commands for each step
steps = [''Next'', ''Next'', ''Next'', ''Next'', ''Next'', ''Arrived'']
print\(\)
print\(''=''*60\)
print\(''VOICE COMMAND INTERACTION''\)
print\(''=''*60\)

for i, cmd in enumerate\(steps, 1\):
    print\(\)
    print\(f''USER says: ""{cmd}""''\)
    step = next_navigation_step\(result[''session_id'']\)
    audio = step[''audio_text'']
    prog = step[''progress'']
    print\(f''SYSTEM:''\)
    print\(f''  [AUDIO] ""{audio}""''\)
    print\(f''  [VISUAL] Step {prog[""current_step""]}/{prog[""total_steps""]} | Progress: {prog[""progress_percent""]}%''\)
    if step[''step''].get\(''type''\) == ''arrival'':
        print\(\)
        print\(''*** Navigation Complete ***''\)
        break

        print\(f''Route: {start} -> {dest}''\)
        print\(f''Steps: {len\(result[""steps""]\)}''\)
